claims.statement: Industry guidance describes formal waste-heat agreements covering ownership boundaries, supply and offtake obligations, metering, price and term, and TRIMET reports a 20-year industrial-heat cooperation agreement; the founder can therefore seek a time-limited exclusive option over measured heat output and matching rights rather than owning pipes or plant.

EU energy-efficiency rules require installation-level cost-benefit analysis for new or substantially refurbished industrial installations above stated energy-input thresholds to assess on- and off-site waste-heat use; the measurable loss is metered recoverable heat still rejected while a positive use case is delayed or missed.

The budget owners are the industrial site's energy director, a district-heating utility or an infrastructure developer, triggered by a required CBA, refurbishment or nearby heat-network plan; documented long-term heat supply contracts show that industrial supplier and heat utility can fund metering, connection and contracted energy.

contrary_evidence: EU rules explicitly allow a finding that heat recovery is not technically or economically feasible, especially where demand is distant or seasonal.
A signed option has little value without a creditworthy heat buyer, permits, pipe route and project finance.

economics.acquisition_route: Use the parents' Greater Poland industrial and renewable network to identify factories before refurbishment, fund a bounded heat survey, and exchange that work for a 12-18 month exclusive development option subject to minimum heat-quality evidence.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Secure five options, close one sub-10 MWth demonstration for an origination fee and metered royalty, then build a 100 MWth portfolio across 15-25 sites; PLN 3m-6m annual development and royalty income plus retained project interests could support PLN 5m founder net worth in 6-9 years, but project conversion may be slow.
economics.founder_time: Founder handles geospatial matching and option economics for 3 hours daily; heat engineers, permitting counsel and project-finance partners perform site work and construction.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Origination fees and royalties have high accounting margin after outsourced surveys; preliminary portfolio gross margin is 50-70%, excluding capital-intensive project SPVs.
economics.payback: Cap each site-screening spend and require option reimbursement at feasibility; one closed project should repay the failed-screen portfolio, while the heat buyer targets savings versus incumbent heat over the contract term.
economics.pricing: PLN 50,000-250,000 success fee per bankable supplier-buyer pair plus 2-5% of metered heat revenue or a minority carried interest in the project SPV.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Successful projects use 10-20 year supply and offtake agreements; new factories and heat-demand points continually replenish the option pipeline.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A proprietary geospatial map of measured heat curves, buyer demand and pipe-route outcomes improves site selection, while signed site options exclude rival originators during development.
fingerprint.customer: Medium industrial heat emitters and district-heating, greenhouse, drying or commercial heat buyers in western and central Poland.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Local installer and industrial-accountant introductions, regulatory CBA referrals, and targeted geospatial outreach to nearby heat users.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Option and develop orphaned waste-heat rights, then sell or co-develop a contracted supplier-buyer project for fees and long-tail royalties.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: An infrastructure developer or heat buyer pays when an exclusive, metered and contract-ready heat pair reaches feasibility or financial close.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Industrial refurbishment, a mandatory waste-heat CBA, boiler replacement, or a heat network's need for a lower-carbon source.

founder_fit: The parents' renewable-installation business can open local industrial doors and provide field credibility without requiring the founder to own construction.
Geospatial matching, load-curve analysis and project screening fit the founder's analytical strengths.
Option-based origination limits initial capital and can be worked part-time before a project reaches construction.
risks: Pipe distance, temperature lift, seasonal mismatch and outages can destroy conservative economics.
Industrial sites may refuse exclusivity or disclose unreliable heat data.
Permitting, utility market power and project-finance timelines can exceed the founder's part-time capacity.

structure.control_point: Time-limited exclusive option over a site's measured waste-heat output and matching rights
structure.critical_dependency: A nearby creditworthy heat load with financeable pipe and temperature economics

thesis: Trade a rigorous heat survey for an exclusive option on a factory's otherwise orphaned thermal output, match it to a nearby buyer, and monetize only when the metered supply, offtake and connection become a financeable long-term contract.
title: Orphaned Heat Option Book
uncertainties: The density of viable source-demand pairs in Greater Poland is unknown.
Factories' willingness to grant options before a buyer is identified is untested.
Attainable origination fees, royalty terms and conversion times have not been validated.
